title: Verditius Apprenticeship and Gauntlet
heading: Apprenticeship
summary: How a Verditius apprentice is initiated into the Outer Mystery while the Arts are opened, what the master must know to do it, and how the apprentice's Gauntlet is a masterpiece enchanted item made in an extra season.
quotes: Verditius magi must also have a score of 2 in Verditius Cult Lore.
The parens supplies the necessary vis, and gives the apprentice a season to work unaided in his laboratory.

title: Forge-Companions and Venditores
heading: Journeymen and Masters
summary: Verditius ranks used in the Contest, plus the forge-companions who add to a magus's Lab Total when they share his Craft Ability and the venditores who sell his items to mundanes, and their murky legal status.
quotes: each forge-companion may add +1 per 5 levels of Craft Ability score he possesses to the maga's Lab Total.
A Verditius magus may have a number of forge-companions equal to his Leadership score.

title: Verditius Prices for Enchantments
heading: Prices for Enchantments
summary: The House's standard price for enchanted items sold to other magi (paid in vis) and to mundanes (paid in Mythic Pounds), and the social consequences of undercutting or overcharging.
quotes: The standardized price of an item is twice the vis necessary to make it, in addition to the vis required for the project.
The Primus has decreed that 15 Mythic Pounds times the vis cost of an item is a suitable price.

title: Verditius Vendettas
heading: Vendettas
summary: The non-lethal personal feuds between Verditius magi: how they start, what tactics are acceptable, the Reputation penalty for refusing one, and how the Primus ends escalating ones.
quotes: any magus who refuses a vendetta gains a bad Reputation of Dishonorable 4 in the House

title: Initiation into the Mysteries of Verditius
heading: Initiation into the Mysteries of Verditius
summary: How the general Mystery initiation rules are applied in House Verditius, including the Mystagogue's Initiation Total and the fact that the Outer Mystery needs no Verditius Cult Lore score.
quotes: Initiation Total = Presence + Verditius Cult Lore + Script bonus
A Verditius Initiate does not need a score in Verditius Cult Lore to be initiated into the Outer Mystery of the House.

title: Verditius Initiation Scripts
heading: Verditius Initiation Scripts
summary: The list of Script components specific to Verditius initiations (travel to a Forge, Quests, Ordeals, Sacrifices) and the bonus each one adds to the Initiation Total.
quotes: +6 The Initiate must perform a unique Quest
+3 The Initiate Sacrifices a lesser enchanted item whose combined powers are of at least the fourth magnitude.

title: Verditius Cult Lore
heading: New Ability: Verditius Cult Lore
summary: Describes the Arcane Ability that holds the House's secrets, is raised like any Ability, and can be Trained as well as Taught by any member with a sufficient score.
quotes: Training allows every Verditius magus who has at least a Verditius Cult Lore score of 2 to instruct the lower Initiates in the House's secrets

title: Outer Mystery of Verditius Magic
heading: The Outer Mystery of Verditius Magic
summary: The initiation that every Verditius apprentice undergoes at the Forges of Hephaestus, granting the Verditius Magic Virtue, with its Target Level, Mystagogue requirement and Script bonus.
quotes: Mechanically, the Initiation Target Level is 15.
The Initiation Script has a bonus of +12

title: Initiating Hermetic Magi into Verditius
heading: Initiating Hermetic Magi
summary: The special ritual by which an already-Gauntleted magus of another House joins House Verditius: a probationary period, the Embrace of Boethius that forces reliance on casting tools, Warping, possible Twilight, and the traits and Virtue gained.
quotes: He also develops the Personality Trait Proud 1
He receives the Minor Hermetic Virtue Verditius Magic and gains a Reputation, Convert 1, in the House

title: Learning the Inner Mysteries of Verditius
heading: Learning the Inner Mysteries
summary: The Verditius Cult Lore scores a Mystagogue or Initiate needs at each stage (apprentice initiation, Minor Inner Mysteries, Major Inner Mysteries), and how self-initiation differs from learning from another member.
quotes: A magus must increase his score to 2 before Initiating an apprentice whose Arts he wants to open at the same time.
He should have a Verditius Cult Lore score of 5 before he is Initiated into any of the Major Inner Mysteries.

title: Hubris
heading: Hubris
summary: The Hubris Personality Trait gained with the first Inner Mystery: it grows with experience points from selling and winning, is added to certain Lab Totals, and can be resisted with opposed Personality Trait rolls, notably when refusing a vendetta.
quotes: A Verditius magus can add his Hubris score to his Lab Totals for creating a talisman
you must make an opposed Personality Trait + stress die roll against an Ease Factor of your maga's Hubris score + her challenger's Hubris score

title: Increasing Hubris
heading: Increasing Hubris
summary: A table of behaviors (selling items, winning the Contest, learning Inner Mysteries, vendettas) and the experience points each adds to the Hubris score.
quotes: Winning the master category of the Contest. | 6 |
Selling an automaton. | 1/magnitude of Might |

title: Verditius Ordeals
heading: Ordeals
summary: Sample Ordeals used to initiate Verditius Inner Mysteries (Sever the Ties That Bind, Self-Mutilation, Prone to Chance, Averse to Risk, Increased Hubris), each imposing a Flaw or personality change.
quotes: Each Ordeal may only be used once by a single magus.
The first Ordeal, undertaken to learn the first Minor Inner Mystery, always grants the Minor Flaw Hubris.

title: Verditius Confraternities
heading: Confraternities
summary: Small sub-cults within the House that follow a set Mystery Path with a unique Inner Mystery; four examples (Roland, Balento, Irene the Younger, Himinis the Mad) give the path and a sample Initiation Script with Ease Factor and Script bonus.
quotes: these subsets of magi only contain four to eight followers at any given time

title: Verditius Inner Mysteries Overview
heading: House Verditius Inner Mysteries
summary: Introduces the four Minor and four Major Inner Mysteries, which may be learned in any order, and explains that each comes with a sample Initiation Script at a standard Target Level that can be lowered by an earlier Ordeal.
quotes: There are four Minor and four Major Inner Mysteries of House Verditius.

title: Enchant Casting Tools
heading: Enchant Casting Tools (Minor House Mystery)
requires: Initiation: Enchant Casting Tools (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
summary: A lab activity letting a Verditius magus enchant his casting tools in one season to mirror a mastered spell and add casting bonuses; gives the special Lab Total, the list of extra effects with their level costs, and the vis cost.
quotes: Technique + Form + Intelligence + Magic Theory + Aura modifier + Philosophiae + Hubris + Magnitude of Known Spell + Craft (if applicable)
one pawn of Techniqueor Form-specific vis per 10 levels of the final effect level total, rounded up.

title: Items of Quality
heading: Items of Quality (Minor House Mystery)
requires: Initiation: Items of Quality (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
summary: How a Verditius magus draws out the latent Shape and Material bonus of an ordinary tool in one season for one pawn of Vim vis, giving a roll bonus capped by his Philosophiae; these are not true magic items for Magic Resistance or detection.
quotes: Items of quality are easy to make, and any Verditius maga who knows this Mystery may successfully create one in a single season.
this bonus is limited by the magus's Philosophiae score at the time of creation
Regardless of the bonus these items provide, they have a Lab Total of 10 if investigated.
related: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material bonuses

title: Reforging Enchanted Items
heading: Reforging Enchanted Items (Minor House Mystery)
requires: Initiation: Reforging Enchanted Items (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
summary: Overview of the Mystery that lets a magus repair, reforge or smelt enchanted items by rolling a Creo or Rego Vim Lab Total plus a stress die against the level of each power, one power at a time, over at least a season.
quotes: Creo or Rego Vim Lab Total + stress die vs. level of effect of a power of an enchanted device

title: Repairing Enchanted Items
heading: Repairing Enchanted Items
requires: Initiation: Reforging Enchanted Items (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
summary: Procedure for mending a broken enchanted item: a physical repair roll, then an Intellego Vim investigation of each power, then a Creo Vim roll to rebind each power, with Warping on botches.
quotes: You make a Dexterity + Craft stress roll against an Ease Factor of 9.
If a Verditius magus is accurately told the properties of an item, you may add +20 to your investigation rolls.

title: Reforging Enchanted Devices
heading: Reforging Enchanted Devices
requires: Initiation: Reforging Enchanted Items (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
summary: How to re-craft a finished or merely opened device so it can hold extra vis beyond its normal limit, with the cost in vis, the penalty that raises later effect levels, and the results of failure and botches.
quotes: The reforged item can hold a number of pawns of additional vis equal to his score in Philosophiae at the time of the reforging.
The final instilled levels of effect of each of the reforged device's powers are increased by five times his Philosophiae score
related: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size table

title: Smelting Enchanted Devices
heading: Smelting Enchanted Devices
requires: Initiation: Reforging Enchanted Items (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
summary: A season-long procedure that destroys an enchanted device to recover some of the vis used to make it, limited by Magic Theory and, with Elder Runes, Philosophiae, and with some vis always lost.
quotes: One pawn in ten is always lost, evaporating away during the smelting process.
either by his Magic Theory times two or, if he knows the Inner Mystery Verditius Elder Runes, by his Magic Theory times Philosophiae

title: Verditius Elder Runes
heading: Verditius Elder Runes (Minor House Mystery)
requires: Initiation: Verditius Elder Runes (Verditius Minor Inner Mystery)
summary: Elder runes (a table linking each rune to an Art and a tree) that can be inscribed on an item to double an Art for enchanting at the cost of a higher effect level and vis, with a bonus for matching wood and a higher seasonal vis limit.
quotes: Each rune adds five to the final level of effect of the power being instilled in the device
each inscribed rune allows the magus to double the Art that the rune represents, exactly like a magical focus
It costs a pawn of Art-specific vis to inscribe each elder rune.
related: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.26 (Minor Breakthroughs)

title: Automata
heading: Automata (Major House Mystery)
summary: Introduces the Major Mystery that grants the Craft Automata Ability and the three stages of building an automaton (body, spirit, mind); other Hermetic magi can learn it as a Supernatural Ability.
quotes: Knowing this Mystery grants the Major Hermetic Virtue Craft Automata, an Ability with an initial score of 1.
related: ArM5 p.166 Study Totals for Supernatural Abilities

title: Creating an Automaton
heading: Creating an Automaton
summary: Stage one of automaton construction: choose a species and material to get its Magic Might, pay a vis-equivalent cost in Mythic Pounds, and make an Intelligence + Craft Automata roll with a growing bonus after each failed season.
quotes: Magic MigHt: 10 + Size + Material Base Points
Intelligence + Craft Automata + stress die vs. Automaton's Magic Might
related: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size Table

title: Preparing an Automaton for Enchantment
heading: Preparing an Automaton for Enchantment
summary: Stage two: opening the constructed automaton for enchantment by spending Vim vis equal to its Magic Might in a single season; the result is a greater enchanted item that cannot be a talisman.
quotes: This takes a number of pawns of Vim vis equal to the automaton's Magic Might score.

title: Enchanting an Automaton
heading: Enchanting an Automaton
summary: Stage three: instilling spell-like and Ability-like powers into an automaton, with fixed Range and Target, no Concentration Duration, a 'Cease' command, a vis limit equal to Magic Might, and a list of common automaton powers.
quotes: the maximum number of pawns an automaton can hold equals its Magic Might score
Each power instilled requires one pawn of vis for every ten levels of the power's final effect, rounded up.
This effect adds +3 to the final level of the effect.

title: The Construction Combined (Tie the Threads That Bind)
heading: The Construction Combined
summary: The final step in making an automaton: casting the ritual Rego Vim spell Tie the Threads that Bind, whose level must exceed the automaton's Magic Might by a set margin.
quotes: This spell's level must equal or exceed the finished construct's Magic Might + 15.

title: Automata in Play
heading: Automata in Play
summary: How finished automata act (simple die only, no great successes or botches), the yearly maintenance roll against Magic Might, penalties from lost Might, and spot or seasonal repairs.
quotes: At the end of every year, roll a stress die and compare it to the automaton's Magic Might score.
Ease Factor of (6 + the magnitude of the automaton's Magic Might score)

title: Bind Curse
heading: Bind Curse (Major House Mystery)
requires: Initiation: Bind Curse (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
summary: How a magus binds Minor or Major Curses (Flaw-like maledictions that last seasons or years) into enchanted items: base effect levels, Range, Target and Duration, triggers, Penetration and vis cost.
quotes: The basic enchantment effect level of a Minor Curse is level 25, and the basic enchantment effect level of a Major Curse is 50.
Each conditional trigger adds +3 to the final level of effect of the Curse.
Minor Curses last a number of seasons equal to the item's creator's Magic Theory score at the time of enchantment.

title: Minor Curses
heading: Minor Curses
requires: Initiation: Bind Curse (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
summary: A sample list of Minor Curses (weakened Characteristic, susceptibility to magic, twisted spine, warts, cataracts and more) with the game penalties each inflicts and the Arts used.
quotes: Hermetic magi suffer a –3 to their total Magic Resistance and must roll an additional botch die when botching using Hermetic magic.

title: Major Curses
heading: Major curses
requires: Initiation: Bind Curse (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
summary: A sample list of Major Curses (Aging, leprosy, burning flesh, brittle bones, demon's visage, lust for life, doubt) with the rolls and penalties each imposes.
quotes: A broken bone is treated as a Heavy Wound and heals normally.

title: Removing Curses
heading: Removing Curses
requires: Initiation: Bind Curse (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
summary: The ways a Curse can be lifted: waiting it out, a Perdo Vim spell matching its level, destroying or smelting the bestowing item (Minor Curses), or a powerful Magical or Divine creature.
quotes: The level of the Perdo Vim spell must match the final effect level of the Curse.

title: Bind Magical Creatures
heading: Bind Magical Creatures (Major House Mystery)
requires: Initiation: Bind Magical Creatures (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
summary: Lets a magus drain a magical creature's Magic Might as vis for a greater enchanted item, or permanently bind one of its powers to his Gift, with the Lab Total requirements, costs and permanent loss of Might; also covers Faerie Might and the risk of Warping.
quotes: For every point of Lab Total over the creature's Might score, the magus gains one pawn of vis that is usable toward the enchanted device.
the magus's Rego Vim Lab Total plus Hubris score must be equal to or exceed twice the creature's Magic Might.
Its Might is reduced by 5 times the Might cost necessary for the creature to use the power.

title: Item Attunement
heading: Item Attunement (Major House Mystery)
requires: Initiation: Item Attunement (Verditius Major Inner Mystery)
summary: How a magus prepares a greater enchanted item like a talisman with a larger vis capacity, enchants it with his Hubris added to Lab Totals, then severs its link to him; also the Covet Device trait the item imposes on later owners.
quotes: The item can hold pawns of vis equal to his highest Technique + highest Form + Philosophiae score.
Compare his regular Perdo Vim Lab Total + a stress die to 10 + the maximum number of pawns of vis the device holds.
The device has a Covet Device Personality Trait equal to his Hubris score at the time of creation.
related: ArM5 p.97 Material and Size Table

title: Shape & Material Bonuses: Tools
heading: Tools
summary: An expanded table of tools and the Shape and Material bonus each gives when enchanted, for use in lab totals and items of quality.
quotes: +3 reaping, +3 year-duration effects, +4 effects expressly causing death
related: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material bonuses

title: Shape & Material Bonuses: Trees
heading: Trees
summary: An expanded table of tree woods and the Shape and Material bonus each gives to specific kinds of effect.
quotes: +6 strength, +6 Vim on hostile magic
related: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material bonuses

title: Shape & Material Bonuses: Trees under Special Circumstances
heading: Trees under Special Circumstances
summary: Bonuses for wood that is dead, struck by lightning or a twisted tree in a field, for use alongside the tree table.
quotes: +3 affect living wood, +4 affect dead wood
related: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material bonuses

title: Shape & Material Bonuses: Minerals
heading: Minerals
summary: An expanded table of stones, metals and other minerals and the Shape and Material bonus each gives to specific kinds of effect.
quotes: +5 dragons, +4 wealth, +4 language, +3 long life
related: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material bonuses

title: The Verditius Contest
heading: The Contest
summary: The eighteen-year competition at Verdi in which Verditius magi enter their finest item in apprentice, journeyman and master categories; judging criteria, tie-breaking by the Primus and the order in which winners pick prizes.
quotes: The master category winner selects first, choosing three items for himself, the journeyman winner chooses two, followed by the apprentice winner who chooses a single item.
